definitions: a dark grey metamorphic rock that can be easily split into thin, smooth plates.
a thin plate of slate, especially one used for covering roofs.
a list of candidates for election to a political office or as nominees for an award.
a small writing tablet of slate, formerly used in schools.
examples: The roof was covered with natural slate.
He was on the party's slate for the upcoming election.
The teacher wrote on the slate with chalk.
